entities.name: Network policy
entities.description: Information element used by the network to indicate network policy information to the UE. When not included, the UE interprets it as all bits of the value part coded as zero.

entities.name: Network needs to indicate network policy information
entities.description: Condition that determines when the Network policy IE is included in a message.

entities.name: UE interprets absent IE as all bits zero
entities.description: Behavior where the UE interprets the absence of the Network policy IE as receiving an IE with all bits of the value part coded as zero.

relations.description: The Network policy IE is included when the network needs to indicate network policy information.
Absence of the Network policy IE establishes that the UE shall interpret it as all bits zero.
